paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for four different methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale with values ranging from 1 to 9, and tick labels at regular intervals of 2, with no units specified. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", also has a linear scale with values ranging from 20 to 32, and tick labels at intervals of 2, with no units specified. The plot contains four lines: the Consistency-CE line is purple with circle markers and a dashed style, starting at approximately (1, 20) and ending at (9, 31); the Inconsistency-CE line is dark purple with square markers and a dashed style, starting at approximately (1, 23) and ending at (9, 31); the Inconsistency-CE-MP line is blue with square markers and a dashed style, starting at approximately (1, 23) and ending at (9, 31); and the Consistency-Bi line is red with star markers and a solid style, starting at approximately (1, 26) and ending at (9, 32).
